segments.name: Beeline Loans
segments.description: AI-driven fintech mortgage lender offering QM and Non-QM home loans to digital-first consumers, including property investors and self-employed borrowers.
segments.evidence: Beeline Loans is an AI-driven fintech mortgage lender that develops proprietary software in the form of major enhancements and new developments in its lending platform, including Beeline's Chatbot "Bob."

segments.name: Beeline Title Holdings
segments.description: Provides title and loan closing services for the mortgage origination business and the BeelineEquity product.
segments.evidence: Beeline Title Holdings provides title and loan closing services for Beeline's mortgage origination business.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay origination and title fees, and aggregators pay a predetermined price when the company sells its closed loans.
revenueModel.evidence: This is a fee charged to a borrower to offset the costs of origination.

changes.text: Nimble and its subsidiaries were dissolved in 2025, and their results are reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The operating results of Nimble and its subsidiaries have been classified as discontinued operations during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.
